title: Derivative-consistent retention with analytical conductivity
question: Can the derivative-consistent adaptive theta/C interpolant paired with analytical K close the full 12-case F-AHL10 fidelity matrix and still reduce constitutive and complete Richards solve cost?

candidate.capacity: derivative of the same interpolant via chain rule
candidate.conductivity: authoritative analytical K evaluated from represented theta
candidate.near_saturation: authoritative analytical handling for h>-1 cm

stage_1.advance_rule: all 12 cases pass and iteration/backtracking deltas remain zero

stage_2.advance_rule: candidate faster than full analytical theta+C+K for all four materials

stage_3.scope: long paired FSI24-style Reference Richards timing
